1.0 Ground Profile

LayerThickness (m)γ (kN/m³)c′ (kPa)φ′ (°)δ (°)Su (kPa)E (MPa)νAction

Ground Model

Schematic only, not to scale. Hw = 0.5B tan(45° + φ′/2), measured downward from foundation base. For circular footing, B is the diameter. Layer thickness is measured from ground surface; the last layer extends indefinitely. The unit-weight averaging depth for bearing capacity is calculated separately for each load case using its effective width B′.

2.0 Load Case Design Inputs

Compacted Hardfill/Ground Improvement Properties

The base interface value is calculated from the hardfill strength and interface reduction factor. Confirm the adopted parameters and applicability for the project.

Vertical load position defaults to X = B/2 and Y = L/2 when left blank. For rectangular foundations, both positive and negative moment directions are assessed and the minimum effective dimensions are adopted. Enter X and Y for the combined structure-load resultant (excluding separately calculated footing self-weight). Entered structure weights exclude footing self-weight Wc. Design axial loads include Wc. For ULS, the footing weight is multiplied by the dead-load factor Φ; for SLS, Wc remains unfactored.

4.0 Bearing Capacity Factors

Bearing capacity factors are calculated using NZ B1/VM2 (2025) method, except compressibility factors, which use Vesic (1973) method. See Appendix A for details.
